Record actual failures, no skips, fixture cleanup, the callback/expiry holds and any timing or logger-attribution limits. Do not silently retry failures; record and investigate. No permanent source/test edits, commits, pushes, public comments or contributor-branch writes by the gate worker. Publish a receipt and report with expected-failure and control outcomes separately and executor-stop evidence before release.
